title: btHID Mouse
author: @lunokjod
description:
This board as the mouse of another device: the empty page is the pointer, a finger that walks moves it and a tap clicks. Turn the radio on, pair with the name on the page, and the pad is live.
This board is a keyboard and a mouse at once: the keys are the app beside this one, and switching between them does not ask the other device to pair again.
